comparison.objective: Refit a washed baffle filter into a range hood and secure it with its spring latch.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-panel alignment, trough insertion, flattening, latch engagement, and collision-free release.
comparison.success_condition: Bottom edge in trough, filter aligned within 3 mm and 3 degrees, latch returned within 1.5 mm, released for one second; dropping after lift zeros the run. Other damage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both involve seating and releasing a large object, this tests panel insertion and latching rather than manipulating a perforated tool to separate granular media.
